statements.t: We plan to continue to leverage the technical and business expertise of our management team and scientific collaborators to license, acquire and develop additional therapeutics to expand our pipeline.
SNDX-62122 is the first molecule from our library of internally developed and wholly owned next-generation menin inhibitors that we intend to advance into new areas.
We expect the development of SNDX-62122 to be informed and de-risked by a planned Phase 1/2 proof-of-principle trial of revumenib in MF.
We expect to have a major presence at upcoming medical meetings, with the presentation in the fourth quarter of 2026 of new/updated revumenib data including:
We expect to publish safety and efficacy data from R/R NUP98r acute leukemia patients treated with revumenib in the fourth quarter of 2026.
These data provide the basis for our plans to develop SNDX-62122, an internally developed, next-generation menin inhibitor, for MF.
We expect the RAVEN trial to initiate in the fourth quarter of 2026.
We expect the MenTain Phase 2 trial to initiate in the first quarter of 2027.
The Company expects topline data from the Phase 2 trial of axatilimab in combination with ruxolitinib to be presented at a medical meeting in the first quarter of 2027.
The Company expects topline data from the Phase 3 trial of axatilimab in combination with corticosteroids in early 2028.
We expect to submit an investigational new drug (IND) application for SNDX-4321 by the end of 2026 and to initiate a Phase 1 trial in EGFRm NSCLC in 2027.

In accordance with Topic ASC 808, Collaboration Arrangements, Incyte has been identified as the principal in product sales, and therefore we will recognize our 50% share of any profits or losses in the amount of net product sales less cost of goods sold and shared commercial and other expenses, in the period in which the underlying sales and costs are recognized.

Our share of net profits in connection with commercialization of Niktimvo will be presented as “Collaboration revenue, net” and our share of net losses will be presented as “Collaboration loss, net” within operating expenses.
We will continue to recognize the costs associated with ongoing development services in the R&D operating expense line, including any cost-sharing components with Incyte.

We plan to continue to spend a significant amount of our resources on research and development activities for the foreseeable future as we continue to advance the development of our products and product candidates.
The amount of research and development expenses allocated to external spending will continue to grow, while we expect our internal spending to grow at a slower and more controlled pace.

At this time, we cannot reasonably estimate the nature, timing or costs of the efforts that will be necessary to complete the remainder of the development of our products and additional product candidates for the period, if any, in which material net cash inflows from these potential product candidates may commence.
Upon conversion, we will pay or deliver, at our election, cash, shares of our common stock, or a combination of cash and shares of common stock.

Our primary uses of capital are, and we expect will continue to be, compensation and related expenses, third-party clinical research and development services, clinical costs, commercialization costs, legal and other regulatory expenses and general
We have based our estimates on assumptions that may prove to be incorrect, and we could use our capital resources sooner than we currently expect.

the outcome, timing and cost of seeking and obtaining additional regulatory approvals from the FDA and comparable foreign regulatory authorities, including the potential for such authorities to require that we perform more trials than we currently expect;
We expect to continue to support our future cash needs through a combination of equity offerings, debt financings and additional funding from license and collaboration arrangements.

Except for any obligations of our collaborators to reimburse us for research and development expenses or to make milestone or royalty payments under our agreements with them, we will not have any committed external source of liquidity.
We anticipate that we will likely continue to incur significant losses for at least the next couple years.

To the extent that we raise additional capital through the future sale of equity or debt, the ownership interest of our stockholders will be diluted, and the terms of these securities may include liquidation or other preferences that adversely affect the rights of our existing common stockholders.
Our common stock will be sold at prevailing market prices at the time of the sale, and as a result, prices may vary.
